title: A test script exists
rationale: The fastest feedback loop is the one every contributor and CI can run with one command.

title: Pure logic has property-based tests
rationale: Example tests miss the inputs nobody thought of; properties find them (merge, parsing, migrations).

title: The real build is tested end to end
rationale: Unit tests do not catch what the bundler or the browser does to your code.

title: Every bug fix starts with a failing test
rationale: A test written after the fix proves nothing about the bug.
hint: Reproduce first, commit the red test, then fix.
